page.layout: One page of text, centred top block with marginal notes faint and mostly illegible below a rule; the main text block at top; faint show-through and bleed-through text in the lower half (not transcribed); catchword/signature signature line at foot.

main_text.p: pugnat contra k remedium incontinentiæ à Deo 1 omnibus ex æquo indultum, & promissione divina caret. Votum obedientiæ & missionis, prout à Pontificiis describitur, est obedire Hominibus magis quam Deo: h Pro. 30. 8, 9. Pro. 3. 10. 16. i 1 Tim. 5. 8. k 1 Cor. 7, 9. l Heb. 13. 4.

page.notes: The lower half of the page carries only faint, largely illegible marginal and show-through text, which is not transcribed. The signature "D 4" and the catchword "Cap." appear at the foot. The marginal reference marks are read as printed; the note bodies themselves are illegible on the scan.
